title: Moon 0.4.4 beta
notes:
[Download Moon for Mac](https://github.com/madetonight/moon-browser/releases/download/v0.4.4-beta/Moon-0.4.4-arm64.dmg)

One installer for Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later. The same signed DMG powers installation and in-app updates.

- Recover from temporary update connection failures with at most two retries, backoff, and connectivity awareness. Certificate, signature, malformed-feed, and installation errors remain terminal.
- Keep Sparkle's normal no-new-update result from overwriting a successful check with a failure. Settings displays the actual update status.
- Keep errors and completions from an older navigation from covering a newer page. New loads clear an earlier failure immediately.
- Reduce unnecessary password-field scans on Gmail and other changing pages while preserving dynamic login detection.
- Preserve native WebKit image resolution, video playback, cache validation, and TLS checks. Gmail is never automatically reloaded by this change.
- What's New shows this version only.

Full local regression suite: 508 checks passed, one existing WebKit check skipped. A native WebKit regression verifies that message updates avoid password scans while inserted and removed sign-in forms remain detected.

Installed app approximately 11.33 MB; download approximately 5.10 MB. Personal browsing data, credentials, and diagnostic logs are excluded.

This beta is Apple Development signed and is not Apple-notarized. GitHub's automatic source-code links contain source, not extra app installers.
